using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Emby.Server.Implementations.Data;
using Jellyfin.Database.Implementations;
using Jellyfin.Server.Migrations.Routines;
using Jellyfin.Server.ServerSetupApp;
using Microsoft.Data.Sqlite;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Jellyfin.Server.Migrations.Routines.Tests;

public class ReseedFolderFlagTests
{
    private readonly Mock<IStartupLogger<ReseedFolderFlag>> _mockLogger;
    private readonly Mock<IServerApplicationPaths> _mockPaths;
    private readonly Mock<IDbContextFactory<JellyfinDbContext>> _mockDbContextFactory;
    private readonly ReseedFolderFlag _migration;

    public ReseedFolderFlagTests()
    {
        _mockLogger = new Mock<IStartupLogger<ReseedFolderFlag>>();
        _mockLogger.SetupAllProperties();

        _mockPaths = new Mock<IServerApplicationPaths>();
        _mockDbContextFactory = new Mock<IDbContextFactory<JellyfinDbContext>>();

        _migration = new ReseedFolderFlag(
            _mockLogger.Object,
            _mockDbContextFactory.Object,
            _mockPaths.Object);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task PerformAsync_RerunGuardFlagTrue_LogsSkipMessageAndReturns()
    {
        // Arrange
        ReseedFolderFlag.RerunGuardFlag = true;

        // Act
        await _migration.PerformAsync(CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        _mockLogger.Verify(x => x.LogInformation("Migration is skipped because it does not apply."), Times.Once);
        _mockLogger.Verify(x => x.LogInformation(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<object[]>()), Times.Exactly(1)); // Only the skip message
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task PerformAsync_LibraryDbDoesNotExist_LogsErrorAndReturns()
    {
        // Arrange
        ReseedFolderFlag.RerunGuardFlag = false;
        _mockPaths.Setup(x => x.DataPath).Returns("/data");
        // File.Exists("/data/library.db.old") will return false

        // Act
        await _migration.PerformAsync(CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        _mockLogger.Verify(x => x.LogError("Cannot migrate IsFolder flag from {LibraryDb} as it does not exist. This migration expects the MigrateLibraryDb to run first.", "/data/library.db.old"), Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task PerformAsync_LibraryDbExistsWithFolderItems_LogsMigratingCountMessage()
    {
        // Arrange
        ReseedFolderFlag.RerunGuardFlag = false;
        var dataPath = Path.GetTempPath();
        var libraryDbPath = Path.Combine(dataPath, "library.db.old");
        
        // Create temp SQLite DB with folder items
        using (var tempConnection = new SqliteConnection($"Filename={libraryDbPath};Mode=Create"))
        {
            await tempConnection.OpenAsync();
            await tempConnection.ExecuteAsync("""
                CREATE TABLE TypedBaseItems (
                    guid TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    IsFolder INTEGER
                )
                """);
            
            // Insert 3 folder items
            await tempConnection.ExecuteAsync("""
                INSERT INTO TypedBaseItems (guid, IsFolder) VALUES 
                ('guid1', 1), ('guid2', 1), ('guid3', 1)
                """);
        }

        _mockPaths.Setup(x => x.DataPath).Returns(dataPath);

        // Mock DbContext to avoid actual DB operations
        var mockDbContext = new Mock<JellyfinDbContext>();
        _mockDbContextFactory.Setup(x => x.CreateDbContextAsync(It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
            .ReturnsAsync(mockDbContext.Object);

        try
        {
            // Act
            await _migration.PerformAsync(CancellationToken.None);

            // Assert - Verifies the specific LogInformation call on line 67
            _mockLogger.Verify(x => x.LogInformation("Migrating the IsFolder flag for {Count} items.", 3), Times.Once);
            
            // Also verify the initial migration start message
            _mockLogger.Verify(x => x.LogInformation("Migrating the IsFolder flag from library.db.old may take a while, do not stop Jellyfin."), Times.Once);
        }
        finally
        {
            // Cleanup
            if (File.Exists(libraryDbPath))
            {
                File.Delete(libraryDbPath);
            }
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task PerformAsync_NoFolderItemsInLibraryDb_LogsZeroCountMessage()
    {
        // Arrange
        ReseedFolderFlag.RerunGuardFlag = false;
        var dataPath = Path.GetTempPath();
        var libraryDbPath = Path.Combine(dataPath, "library.db.old");
        
        // Create temp SQLite DB with NO folder items
        using (var tempConnection = new SqliteConnection($"Filename={libraryDbPath};Mode=Create"))
        {
            await tempConnection.OpenAsync();
            await tempConnection.ExecuteAsync("""
                CREATE TABLE TypedBaseItems (
                    guid TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    IsFolder INTEGER
                )
                """);
            // No inserts - empty table
        }

        _mockPaths.Setup(x => x.DataPath).Returns(dataPath);
        var mockDbContext = new Mock<JellyfinDbContext>();
        _mockDbContextFactory.Setup(x => x.CreateDbContextAsync(It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
            .ReturnsAsync(mockDbContext.Object);

        try
        {
            // Act
            await _migration.PerformAsync(CancellationToken.None);

            // Assert - Verifies the LogInformation call with count = 0
            _mockLogger.Verify(x => x.LogInformation("Migrating the IsFolder flag for {Count} items.", 0), Times.Once);
        }
        finally
        {
            if (File.Exists(libraryDbPath))
            {
                File.Delete(libraryDbPath);
            }
        }
    }
}
